methods.name: get
methods.summary: Returns the expected DNS records for a sending subdomain.
methods.description: Returns the expected DNS records for a sending subdomain.

methods.name: create
methods.summary: Creates a new sending subdomain or re-enables sending on an existing subdomain that had it disabled.
methods.description:
Creates a new sending subdomain or re-enables sending on an existing subdomain
that had it disabled. If zone-level Email Sending has not been enabled yet, the
zone flag is automatically set when the entitlement is present. A leftmost
wildcard such as `*.example.com` is accepted only for accounts with wildcard
Email Sending enabled. Wildcard senders share the base domain's DKIM signing
identity and `cf-bounce.<base>` return path.

props.name: name
props.description:
The domain name within the zone. A wildcard is allowed only as the
complete leftmost label (`*.example.com`) and requires the account wildcard
Email Sending entitlement.

methods.name: list
methods.summary: Lists all sending-enabled subdomains for the zone.
methods.description: Lists all sending-enabled subdomains for the zone.

methods.name: delete
methods.summary: Disables sending on a subdomain and removes its DNS records.
methods.description:
Disables sending on a subdomain and removes its DNS records. If routing is still
active on the subdomain, only sending is disabled.

methods.name: get
methods.summary: Gets information for a specific sending subdomain.
methods.description: Gets information for a specific sending subdomain.

methods.name: send
methods.summary: Send an email for the specified account using the structured builder.
methods.description:
Send an email for the specified account using the structured builder. Provide
the sender, recipients, subject, and at least one of text or html; attachments
are optional.

props.name: from
name
props.description:
Display name for the email address (e.g., 'John Doe'). Optional; set to null or
leave it unset to send the address on its own.

Sender email address. Either a plain string or an object with
address and name.

props.name: content_id
props.description: Content ID used to reference this attachment in HTML via cid: URI (e.g., ).

props.name: disposition
props.description: Use 'inline' to embed the attachment in the email body.

props.name: bcc
name
props.description:
Display name for the email address (e.g., 'John Doe'). Optional; set to null or
leave it unset to send the address on its own.

Recipient(s). Optional if cc or bcc is provided. A single email
string, a named address object, or an array of either.

props.name: cc
name
props.description:
Display name for the email address (e.g., 'John Doe'). Optional; set to null or
leave it unset to send the address on its own.

Recipient(s). Optional if cc or bcc is provided. A single email
string, a named address object, or an array of either.

props.name: headers
props.description: Custom email headers as key-value pairs.

props.name: html
props.description:
HTML body of the email. Provide at least one of text or html
(non-empty).

props.name: reply_to
name
props.description:
Display name for the email address (e.g., 'John Doe'). Optional; set to null or
leave it unset to send the address on its own.

Reply-to address. Either a plain string or an object with address
and name.

props.name: text
props.description:
Plain text body of the email. Provide at least one of text or html
(non-empty).

props.name: to
name
props.description:
Display name for the email address (e.g., 'John Doe'). Optional; set to null or
leave it unset to send the address on its own.

Recipient(s). Optional if cc or bcc is provided. A single email
string, a named address object, or an array of either.

methods.name: sendRaw
methods.summary: Send a raw RFC 5322 (MIME) email for the specified account.
methods.description:
Send a raw RFC 5322 (MIME) email for the specified account. Provide the full
MIME message plus the SMTP envelope (from and recipients).

props.name: mime_message
props.description:
The full MIME-encoded email message. Should include standard RFC
5322 headers such as From, To, Subject, and Content-Type. The from and
recipients fields in the request body control SMTP envelope routing; the From
and To headers in the MIME message control what the recipient's email client
displays.
